description.returns: Its kind and the kinds that kind specialises, the individuals holding it ('held as <field> of a <Kind>'), and each field with its meaning and value, held individuals described in turn down to the depth asked; '(default)' marks a field's declared default rather than a measurement; individuals beyond the depth appear as 'see <handle>'.
description.use_when: Learning what an individual is and holds.
description.avoid: Describing an individual marked 'see <handle>' unless it matters.

handle.description: The individual's handle, exactly as a tool's answer gave it, written '<Kind>#<n>'.

depth.description: How many levels of held individuals to describe.
